ChangeSource.description: Which side originated the change at a given path.

WireFieldChange.description:
Wire shape for a `FieldChange` at the WASM boundary.

Wire contract: an ABSENT `new_from_a`/`new_from_b` key means that side didn't touch the field (domain `None`); a PRESENT key — including `null` — means it changed, possibly to `null` (domain `Some(value)`, where `value` may itself be `Value::Null`). This is why the fields are `Option<Option<Value>>` with `skip_serializing_if`/a custom deserializer instead of plain `Option<Value>`, which serde would otherwise collapse `Some(Value::Null)` and `None` into the same wire `null`.
